title: ScenarioConfig
description: Evaluator-defined input parameters consumed by Module 1 (Dynamic Scenario Generation) before generating a VR hostage-rescue training scenario.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier for forward compatibility.

missionStructure.description: Physical layout and building structure parameters. All scenarios are single-floor.

missionType.description: Mission template identifier. Currently only hostage_rescue is supported; reserved for future expansion.

roomCount.description: Min/max range for number of rooms. Generator selects within range based on randomness level and layout type constraints.

min.description: Minimum number of rooms to generate.

max.description: Maximum number of rooms to generate.

roomSize.description: Room dimension category. Mapped to Unity world units: small=4x4m, medium=6x6m, large=8x8m.

layoutType.description: Room graph topology. linear=sequential chain; branching=tree with decision points; hub_and_spoke=central room with radiating corridors; loop=cyclical paths allowing flanking.

entryType.description: Number of building entry points. single=one breach point; multiple=2-3 entry points.

hostageCount.description: Number of hostage NPCs. Fixed to 1 for the current implementation stage to reduce scenario complexity. Reserved for future expansion (range 1-5).

terroristCount.description: Number of terrorist NPCs. Each receives a role assignment (patrol, stationary guard, roaming guard, hostage guardian) based on spatial structure and difficulty.

placementStrategy.description: Spatial distribution pattern. clustered=entities in adjacent rooms creating compounding tactical effects [5]; dispersed=spread across layout; front_loaded=near entry; deep=far from entry in high-depth rooms.

hostageRiskLevel.description: Proximity constraint between the hostage and terrorists using distance thresholds [16]. high=small max distance (closely guarded); medium=moderate spacing; low=large min distance (separated from threats).

executionControls.description: Generation behaviour, difficulty scaling, and reproducibility parameters.

difficultyLevel.description: Overall difficulty (1=easiest, 5=hardest). Higher values place NPCs in tactically challenging positions such as behind doors or at sightline intersections [3], increase role assignment complexity, and tighten navigation context.

randomnessLevel.description: Structural variation between scenarios generated from the same config. low=minimal variation; medium=moderate; high=maximum variation in room positions, sizes, and connectivity [8][13].

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Same seed + same config = identical output. null=system-generated random seed. The used seed is always recorded in output configurationMetadata.

timeLimit.description: Optional mission time limit in seconds. null=no time constraint. Passed through to runtime modules; does not affect generation logic.

customLabel.description: Evaluator-defined label for tagging the scenario (e.g., session ID, training cohort). Stored in configurationMetadata for traceability [22].
